sections.heading: Mission
sections.contentMarkdown:
Design a 30-minute weekly business review with three metrics, three AI questions and one recorded decision. You are designing the routine; precise data or an actual AI call are not required today.

**Submission:**

1. Set a fixed review day and time.
2. Name metric 1 and why it matters.
3. Name metric 2 and why it matters.
4. Name metric 3 and why it matters.
5. Write AI question 1.
6. Write AI question 2.
7. Write AI question 3.
8. Give an example decision to record for the first week.

**Evaluation Criteria:**

| Dimension | Weight | Criteria |
|---|---|---|
| Complete routine | 60% | Include three metrics, three questions and a fixed appointment. |
| Recordable decision | 40% | Give a clear example of a weekly decision rather than a vague intention. |
